actions.action: Commit deduplication and business changes together
actions.mechanism: A unique event key and business update share one transaction; acknowledgement follows durable commit.
actions.implementation: Insert a partner-scoped event ID. Only the successful inserter applies the update. On duplicate conflict, acknowledge without reapplying.
actions.check: Crash before commit and after commit but before acknowledgement; replay concurrently. Verify exactly one committed business update.
actions.risk: External side effects require separate idempotency; this transaction protects database changes only.

actions.action: Guard entity updates with durable revision checks
actions.mechanism: An atomic revision comparison prevents stale events and concurrent deliveries from overwriting newer state.
actions.implementation: Within the deduplication transaction, update only when incoming revision exceeds stored revision; record stale events without changing business state.
actions.check: Deliver revisions 12, 11, 12 concurrently and after deduplication expiry; verify revision 12 remains and its update never repeats.
actions.risk: Delta events need gap buffering rather than skipping missing revisions.

actions.action: Expire event records without weakening replay protection
actions.mechanism: Seven-day event retention bounds storage; persistent entity revisions protect against replays after event-record deletion.
actions.implementation: Expire strictly after first receipt plus seven days, without refreshing duplicates. Measure total deduplication storage, including indexes and revision tombstones; enforce 2 GB.
actions.check: Replay immediately before, exactly at, and after expiry, including during cleanup. Load one million 64-byte-average IDs; verify allocated storage stays within budget.
actions.risk: Deleted entities need revision tombstones; reject new work before acknowledgement if storage cannot fit.
